verdict.rationale: Kling documents an agent-readable llms.txt, a RESTful API with JWT auth and regional endpoints, and an MCP/CLI surface for agents. Together these support submitting generations from docs. A per-unit USD price table lets an agent estimate cost, but the pack never documents job-status polling, asset download, or per-job cost reporting from the API. Missing for 10: documented task-status/polling endpoint, documented asset retrieval/download flow, API-returned per-job cost or credit usage, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost
